title: STAGE: Subspace-Targeted Affine Generative Erasure for Text-to-3D Models
title_zh: STAGE：面向文本到三维模型的子空间定向仿射生成擦除

paragraphs.en: Concept erasure suppresses a target concept while preserving behavior on unrelated inputs. Existing closed-form methods were designed for 2D image diffusion and assume a single generative pathway, so one edit must cover geometry and texture at once. Native 3D generators, which synthesize structured 3D representations directly rather than by lifting 2D samples, violate this assumption. We show that shape and object concepts must be erased in the structural stage of the pipeline and material concepts in the appearance stage. We therefore formulate erasure in native text-to-3D as a stage-aware editing problem and introduce STAGE, a training-free, closed-form framework. STAGE confines each edit to the low-dimensional subspace spanned by the differences between erase and anchor embeddings, and relaxes the norm-preserving (orthogonal) constraint of prior editors into a least-squares affine correction that maps target activations onto safe anchors subject to a penalty on the displacement of retained prompts. The correction applies to the structural stage, the appearance stage, or both. We find that the stage an edit must reach is determined by concept type. On TRELLIS, the standard open native 3D generator, across 15 shape, material, and object concepts, STAGE reaches 66.7 on a composite score that balances forgetting the target concept against preserving everything else, aggregating CLIP-based semantic and physical metrics, versus 53.2 for the strongest adapted baseline. Code: https://github.com/gmum/STAGE/ Project Page https://gmum.github.io/STAGE/
paragraphs.zh: 概念擦除在抑制目标概念的同时，保留了与无关输入相关的行为。 现有的闭式方法是为二维图像扩散设计的，并假设存在单一生成路径，因此一次编辑必须同时涵盖几何结构和纹理。 原生三维生成器直接合成结构化的三维表示，而非通过提升二维样本实现，因此违背了这一假设。 我们证明，形状和物体概念必须在流程的结构阶段被擦除，而材质概念则需在外观阶段被擦除。 因此，我们将原生文本到三维生成中的擦除问题表述为一个分阶段编辑问题，并提出了 STAGE——一个无需训练、基于闭式的框架。 STAGE 将每次编辑限制在由擦除嵌入与锚定嵌入差异所张成的低维子空间中，并将先前编辑器中保持范数（正交）的约束，放宽为一种最小二乘仿射修正：它将目标激活映射到安全的锚定值上，同时对保留提示的位移施加惩罚。 该修正可应用于结构阶段、外观阶段，或两者同时应用。 我们发现，编辑必须达到的阶段由概念类型决定。 在标准开源原生三维生成器 TRELLIS 上，针对 15 个形状、材质和物体概念，STAGE 在复合得分中达到了 66.7——该得分平衡了对目标概念的遗忘与对其他内容的保留，并综合了基于 CLIP 的语义和物理指标；而最强的自适应基线方法仅得 53.2。 代码：https://github.com/gmum/STAGE/ 项目页面 https://gmum.github.io/STAGE/

paragraphs.en: Native 3D generators synthesize structured 3D representations directly rather than by lifting 2D samples, and now produce high-fidelity assets ( Xiang et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , building on advances in latent diffusion and rectified flows ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) . As these models enter content-creation pipelines, they must be prevented from generating copyrighted, sensitive, or harmful content. In 2D image diffusion, this is the goal of concept erasure, which suppresses a target concept while preserving behavior on unrelated inputs ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ; Kumari et al., 2023 ) . Prior 3D unlearning work ( Wang et al., 2025a ) targets image-to-3D novel-view synthesis models, which output multi-view images rather than 3D representations, and fine-tunes them to forget individual input objects. Erasing text-specified concepts from native text-to-3D generators remains largely unaddressed.
paragraphs.zh: 原生 3D 生成器直接合成结构化的 3D 表示，而不是通过提升 2D 样本来实现，并且现在能够生成高保真资产（Xiang 等人，2025；Zhao 等人，2025；Zhang 等人，2024），这是建立在潜在扩散和修正流领域进展之上的（Rombach 等人，2022；Liu 等人，2023）。 随着这些模型进入内容创作流程，必须防止它们生成受版权保护、敏感或有害的内容。 在 2D 图像扩散中，这是概念擦除的目标，即抑制目标概念，同时保留模型对无关输入的原有行为（Gandikota 等人，2023；Kumari 等人，2023）。 早期的 3D 遗忘研究（Wang 等人，2025a）针对的是图像到 3D 的新视角合成模型，这些模型输出的是多视角图像而非 3D 表示，并通过微调使其忘记单个输入对象。 从原生文本到 3D 生成器中擦除由文本指定的概念这一问题，目前基本尚未得到解决。

paragraphs.en: Training-free closed-form editors avoid the cost of fine-tuning large 3D generators, but were designed for 2D image diffusion, where a single generative pathway means one edit must cover geometry and texture at once (Section 2 ). Native 3D generators violate this assumption. TRELLIS ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) first generates a sparse voxel structure in a structural stage and then, in an appearance stage, generates structured latents on the occupied voxels that encode appearance and fine local geometry, each read through its own cross-attention layers. We show that shape, material, and object concepts depend on different stages of this pipeline. Editing only the appearance stage fails for shape and object concepts, whereas material concepts are erased more effectively there than in the structural stage, and most completely when both stages are edited (Section 4 ). This raises the cost of imprecise edits. An edit applied to a stage that does not carry the target concept can only cause collateral change, and collateral changes in the structural stage propagate to the appearance stage through the scaffold it produces.
paragraphs.zh: 无需训练的闭式编辑器避免了微调大型三维生成器的成本，但它们是为二维图像扩散设计的，其中单一的生成路径意味着一次编辑必须同时涵盖几何形状和纹理（第 2 节）。 原生三维生成器违反了这一假设。 TRELLIS（Xiang 等，2025）首先在结构阶段生成一个稀疏体素结构，然后在外观阶段于被占用的体素上生成结构化的潜在变量，这些变量编码了外观和精细的局部几何信息，每个变量都通过其自身的交叉注意力层进行读取。 我们证明了形状、材质和物体概念依赖于该流程的不同阶段。 仅编辑外观阶段无法处理形状和物体概念，而材质概念在此阶段比在结构阶段更容易被消除，当两个阶段都被编辑时，这种消除效果最为彻底（第 4 节）。 这增加了不精确编辑的成本。 应用于未携带目标概念阶段的编辑只会引起附带变化，而结构阶段中的附带变化会通过其生成的框架传播到外观阶段。

paragraphs.en: We therefore formulate concept erasure in native text-to-3D generation as a stage-aware editing problem and introduce STAGE (Figure 1 ), a training-free, closed-form framework for it. STAGE confines each edit to the low-dimensional subspace spanned by the differences between erase and anchor embeddings, then fits a least-squares affine correction that reads its input only through that subspace and maps target activations onto safe anchors, with a penalty on the displacement of retained prompts (Section 3 ). Because both stages read the same text embeddings, the same correction can be folded exactly into the cross-attention layers of the structural stage, the appearance stage, or both, and we place it according to concept type.

paragraphs.en: Concept-erasure methods differ mainly in when and how they intervene in a pretrained generator. Inference-time methods leave weights untouched, either by steering the sampling trajectory, as in Safe Latent Diffusion ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) , or by projecting cross-attention values away from the erased concept, as in AdaVD ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . Training-based methods fine-tune selected parameters against an erasure objective, including ESD ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ) and later fine-tuning approaches ( Kumari et al., 2023 ; Lu et al., 2024 ) . Closest to our setting, model-editing methods update a small set of text-conditioning layers in closed form, without gradient-based fine-tuning. UCE ( Gandikota et al., 2024 ) solves a least-squares problem that redirects erased concepts while preserving a retain set. RECE ( Gong et al., 2024 ) applies such updates repeatedly to newly derived adversarial embeddings. OCE ( Sun et al., 2026 ) replaces the least-squares update with a norm-preserving rotation obtained from the orthogonal Procrustes problem ( Schönemann, 1966 ) . As we show in Section 3 , a rotation preserves distances and therefore cannot map an erased concept onto a distinct anchor without also moving that anchor. STAGE relaxes this constraint to a least-squares affine correction confined to the subspace spanned by the differences between erase and anchor embeddings. This differs from UCE, whose least-squares update is unconstrained.
paragraphs.zh: 概念消除方法的主要区别在于它们何时以及如何干预预训练生成器。 推理时方法不改变权重，其方式包括引导采样轨迹（如 Safe Latent Diffusion (Schramowski et al., 2023)），或通过将交叉注意力值投影到被消除概念之外（如 AdaVD (Wang et al., 2025b)）。 基于训练的方法通过针对消除目标对选定参数进行微调，包括 ESD (Gandikota et al., 2023) 以及后续的微调方法（Kumari et al., 2023；Lu et al., 2024）。 与我们的设定最接近的是模型编辑方法，它们以闭式形式更新少量文本条件层，而不进行基于梯度的微调。 UCE (Gandikota et al., 2024) 解决一个最小二乘问题，该问题在保留保留集的同时重新引导被消除的概念。 RECE (Gong et al., 2024) 将此类更新重复应用于新推导出的对抗性嵌入。 OCE (Sun et al., 2026) 用通过正交 Procrustes 问题（Schönemann, 1966）获得的保持范数的旋转替代了最小二乘更新。 正如我们在第 3 节中所示，旋转会保持距离不变，因此无法将某个被消除的概念映射到一个不同的锚点，而不同时移动该锚点。 STAGE 将此约束放宽为最小二乘仿射修正，且仅限于消除嵌入与锚点嵌入之差所张成的子空间。 这与 UCE 不同，因为 UCE 的最小二乘更新不受任何约束。

sents.en: Inference-time methods leave weights untouched, either by steering the sampling trajectory, as in Safe Latent Diffusion ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) , or by projecting cross-attention values away from the erased concept, as in AdaVD ( Wang et al., 2025b ) .
sents.zh: 推理时方法不改变权重，其方式包括引导采样轨迹（如 Safe Latent Diffusion (Schramowski et al., 2023)），或通过将交叉注意力值投影到被消除概念之外（如 AdaVD (Wang et al., 2025b)）。

sents.en: Training-based methods fine-tune selected parameters against an erasure objective, including ESD ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ) and later fine-tuning approaches ( Kumari et al., 2023 ; Lu et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 基于训练的方法通过针对消除目标对选定参数进行微调，包括 ESD (Gandikota et al., 2023) 以及后续的微调方法（Kumari et al., 2023；Lu et al., 2024）。

sents.en: Closest to our setting, model-editing methods update a small set of text-conditioning layers in closed form, without gradient-based fine-tuning.
sents.zh: 与我们的设定最接近的是模型编辑方法，它们以闭式形式更新少量文本条件层，而不进行基于梯度的微调。

sents.en: UCE ( Gandikota et al., 2024 ) solves a least-squares problem that redirects erased concepts while preserving a retain set.
sents.zh: UCE (Gandikota et al., 2024) 解决一个最小二乘问题，该问题在保留保留集的同时重新引导被消除的概念。

sents.en: RECE ( Gong et al., 2024 ) applies such updates repeatedly to newly derived adversarial embeddings.
sents.zh: RECE (Gong et al., 2024) 将此类更新重复应用于新推导出的对抗性嵌入。

sents.en: OCE ( Sun et al., 2026 ) replaces the least-squares update with a norm-preserving rotation obtained from the orthogonal Procrustes problem ( Schönemann, 1966 ) .
sents.zh: OCE (Sun et al., 2026) 用通过正交 Procrustes 问题（Schönemann, 1966）获得的保持范数的旋转替代了最小二乘更新。

sents.en: As we show in Section 3 , a rotation preserves distances and therefore cannot map an erased concept onto a distinct anchor without also moving that anchor.
sents.zh: 正如我们在第 3 节中所示，旋转会保持距离不变，因此无法将某个被消除的概念映射到一个不同的锚点，而不同时移动该锚点。

sents.en: STAGE relaxes this constraint to a least-squares affine correction confined to the subspace spanned by the differences between erase and anchor embeddings.
sents.zh: STAGE 将此约束放宽为最小二乘仿射修正，且仅限于消除嵌入与锚点嵌入之差所张成的子空间。

sents.en: This differs from UCE, whose least-squares update is unconstrained.
sents.zh: 这与 UCE 不同，因为 UCE 的最小二乘更新不受任何约束。

paragraphs.en: The methods above were all designed for 2D image diffusion. The only prior 3D-unlearning method we are aware of ( Wang et al., 2025a ) fine-tunes the 2D multi-view diffusion model at the front of an image-to-3D pipeline and leaves the downstream reconstruction stage untouched. STAGE instead edits the text-conditioning layers of a native 3D generator directly, including those of the structural stage, which fixes coarse geometry before appearance is generated and has no counterpart in a 2D pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 上述方法均是为二维图像扩散而设计的。 我们所知的唯一一种三维去学习方法（Wang et al., 2025a）是在图像到三维流程的前端对二维多视角扩散模型进行微调，而下游的重建阶段则保持不变。 STAGE 方法则直接编辑原生三维生成器的文本条件层，包括结构阶段的文本条件层；该结构阶段会在生成外观之前修正粗略的几何形状，这在二维流程中是没有对应环节的。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating concept erasure also changes once the output is a 3D asset rather than an image. Prior work scores 2D erasure with classifier accuracy, CLIP-based similarity ( Hessel et al., 2021 ) , or distributional metrics such as FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , often summarized with a harmonic mean ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . Applied to rendered views alone, such scores depend on the chosen cameras and cannot tell whether a change comes from geometry or from appearance. Section 4 introduces the 3D Unlearning Score, which pairs CLIP scores on rendered views with a point-cloud evaluator for shape and object concepts and a material classifier for material concepts, and measures preservation relative to the unedited model.
paragraphs.zh: 当输出是三维资产而非图像时，对概念消除的评估方式也会随之改变。 先前的工作通过分类器准确率、基于 CLIP 的相似性（Hessel 等人，2021）或 FID 等分布度量指标（Heusel 等人，2017）来评估二维消除效果，这些指标通常用调和平均数进行总结（Sun 等人，2026）。 如果仅将此类评分应用于渲染后的视图，那么它们会依赖于所选的摄像头，且无法判断变化是源于几何结构还是外观。 第 4 节介绍了三维“遗忘”评分（3D Unlearning Score），该评分将渲染视图上的 CLIP 评分与用于形状和物体概念的点云评估器、以及用于材料概念的材料分类器相结合，并衡量其相对于未编辑模型的保留程度。

paragraphs.en: Following TRELLIS ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) , we write the generator as two cascaded stages, a structural stage 𝒢 S \mathcal{G}_{S} and a latent appearance stage 𝒢 L \mathcal{G}_{L} . A text prompt is encoded by a frozen text encoder ( Radford et al., 2021 ) into an embedding c c . Given c c , the structural stage first constructs the underlying geometric scaffold (the active voxel support), and the appearance stage then generates appearance and fine local geometry on that fixed support. Both stages read the same embedding independently, each through its own cross-attention layers. Because 𝒢 S \mathcal{G}_{S} and 𝒢 L \mathcal{G}_{L} are separate networks, an edit can be folded into either one, or both, without changing the other’s weights. Figure 2 shows the full procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 TRELLIS（Xiang 等人，2025），我们将生成器分为两个级联阶段：结构阶段 𝒢 S \mathcal{G}_{S} 和潜在外观阶段 𝒢 L \mathcal{G}_{L}。 文本提示由一个冻结的文本编码器（Radford 等人，2021）编码为嵌入向量 c c 。 给定 c c ，结构阶段首先构建底层的几何框架（即活跃的体素支撑），随后外观阶段在该固定支撑上生成外观和精细的局部几何结构。 两个阶段都独立读取相同的嵌入向量，各自通过自身的交叉注意力层进行。 由于 𝒢 S \mathcal{G}_{S} 和 𝒢 L \mathcal{G}_{L} 是独立的网络，因此编辑可以整合到其中一个或两个阶段中，而无需改变另一个阶段的权重。 图 2 展示了完整的流程。

paragraphs.en: Mode-S: fold the correction only into 𝒢 S \mathcal{G}_{S} ’s layers, leaving appearance untouched (assigned to shape concepts).
paragraphs.zh: 模式-S：仅将修正折叠到 𝒢 S \mathcal{G}_{S} 的层中，保持外观不变（分配给形状概念）。

paragraphs.en: The updates of UCE and OCE are not restricted to a subspace, so any input can be affected. UCE constrains the change only on the concepts in its preservation term, and OCE’s rotation acts on the whole output space of the projection. paragraphs.zh: UCE 和 OCE 的更新不受限于任何子空间，因此任何输入都可能受到影响。 UCE 仅对其保留项中的概念施加变化约束，而 OCE 的旋转则作用于投影的整个输出空间。 在级联式三维架构中，这一点比在单一网络中更为重要。 𝒢 S \mathcal{G}_{S} 读取无关提示方式的任何不必要变化，都会改变 𝒢 L \mathcal{G}_{L} 随后生成外观时所用的体素支撑结构，因此级联早期的一小扰动最终会导致最终资产出现可见的变化。

paragraphs.en: STAGE instead restricts the correction to a small, data-driven subspace built directly from the erase and anchor pairs, rather than the whole embedding space. We write C erase C_{\text{erase}} and C anchor C_{\text{anchor}} to be template-parallel . Erase prompt i i and its anchor prompt differ only in the concept word itself, so the difference between their text embeddings is dominated by the directions that encode that concept. We pair their text-encoder outputs at every aligned token position rather than only their last-token summary, so each prompt pair contributes several per-token difference vectors. From here on, c i c_{i} and c i ∗ c^{*}_{i} denote the i i -th aligned pair of erase and anchor token states, and k k the number of such pairs. Collecting the differences δ i = c i − c i ∗ \delta_{i}=c_{i}-c^{*}_{i} into a matrix Δ = [ δ 1 ⋯ δ k ] \Delta=[\delta_{1}\,\cdots\,\delta_{k}] and taking its SVD, the leading r r left singular vectors D ∈ ℝ d × r D\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times r} span a subspace V V along which erase and anchor concepts actually differ, r = 16 r{=}16 dimensions by default out of the full embedding width d = 768 d{=}768 . The correction we fit below depends on an input only through its projection D ⊤ ​ c D^{\top}c onto V V , plus one constant offset shared by every input. An unrelated prompt is therefore displaced only through its projection onto V V and the shared offset, and the objective below penalizes this displacement on a retained set of prompts we want left alone. Because the offset is shared by every input, this penalty keeps it small wherever it would move retained prompts.
paragraphs.zh: STAGE 则将修正限制在一个由擦除和锚点词对直接构建的、数据驱动的小子空间中，而非整个嵌入空间。 我们将 C erase C_{\text{erase}} 和 C anchor C_{\text{anchor}} 写作模板平行的形式。 擦除提示 i i 及其锚点提示仅在概念词本身不同，因此它们文本嵌入之间的差异主要由编码该概念的方向决定。 我们在每个对齐的令牌位置对其文本编码器输出进行配对，而不仅仅是它们的最后一个令牌的摘要，因此每对提示都会贡献多个每个令牌的差异向量。 从此刻起，c i c_{i} 和 c i ∗ c^{*}_{i} 表示第 i i 个对齐的擦除和锚点令牌状态对，而 k k 表示此类对的数量。 将差异 δ i = c i − c i ∗ \delta_{i}=c_{i}-c^{*}_{i} 收集到矩阵 Δ = [ δ 1 ⋯ δ k ] \Delta=[\delta_{1}\,\cdots\,\delta_{k}] 中，并对其执行奇异值分解（SVD），前 r r 个左奇异向量 D ∈ ℝ d × r D\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times r} 张成一个子空间 V V，擦除和锚点概念的实际差异即沿此空间发生，默认情况下 r = 16 r{=}16 维，而总嵌入宽度为 d = 768 d{=}768。 我们在下文拟合的修正仅通过其到 V V 上的投影 D ⊤ ​ c D^{\top}c 依赖于输入，外加一个所有输入共享的常数偏移量。 因此，一个无关的提示仅通过其在 V V 上的投影和共享偏移量被移动，而下文的目标函数会对保留的一组我们希望保持不变的提示上的这种移动进行惩罚。 由于该偏移量由所有输入共享，因此只要它会使保留的提示发生移动，这种惩罚就会使其保持较小。

sents.zh: STAGE 则将修正限制在一个由擦除和锚点词对直接构建的、数据驱动的小子空间中，而非整个嵌入空间。

sents.en: We write C erase C_{\text{erase}} and C anchor C_{\text{anchor}} to be template-parallel .
sents.zh: 我们将 C erase C_{\text{erase}} 和 C anchor C_{\text{anchor}} 写作模板平行的形式。

sents.en: Erase prompt i i and its anchor prompt differ only in the concept word itself, so the difference between their text embeddings is dominated by the directions that encode that concept.
sents.zh: 擦除提示 i i 及其锚点提示仅在概念词本身不同，因此它们文本嵌入之间的差异主要由编码该概念的方向决定。

sents.en: We pair their text-encoder outputs at every aligned token position rather than only their last-token summary, so each prompt pair contributes several per-token difference vectors.
sents.zh: 我们在每个对齐的令牌位置对其文本编码器输出进行配对，而不仅仅是它们的最后一个令牌的摘要，因此每对提示都会贡献多个每个令牌的差异向量。

sents.en: From here on, c i c_{i} and c i ∗ c^{*}_{i} denote the i i -th aligned pair of erase and anchor token states, and k k the number of such pairs.
sents.zh: 从此刻起，c i c_{i} 和 c i ∗ c^{*}_{i} 表示第 i i 个对齐的擦除和锚点令牌状态对，而 k k 表示此类对的数量。

sents.en: Collecting the differences δ i = c i − c i ∗ \delta_{i}=c_{i}-c^{*}_{i} into a matrix Δ = [ δ 1 ⋯ δ k ] \Delta=[\delta_{1}\,\cdots\,\delta_{k}] and taking its SVD, the leading r r left singular vectors D ∈ ℝ d × r D\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times r} span a subspace V V along which erase and anchor concepts actually differ, r = 16 r{=}16 dimensions by default out of the full embedding width d = 768 d{=}768 .
sents.zh: 将差异 δ i = c i − c i ∗ \delta_{i}=c_{i}-c^{*}_{i} 收集到矩阵 Δ = [ δ 1 ⋯ δ k ] \Delta=[\delta_{1}\,\cdots\,\delta_{k}] 中，并对其执行奇异值分解（SVD），前 r r 个左奇异向量 D ∈ ℝ d × r D\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times r} 张成一个子空间 V V，擦除和锚点概念的实际差异即沿此空间发生，默认情况下 r = 16 r{=}16 维，而总嵌入宽度为 d = 768 d{=}768。

sents.en: The correction we fit below depends on an input only through its projection D ⊤ ​ c D^{\top}c onto V V , plus one constant offset shared by every input.
sents.zh: 我们在下文拟合的修正仅通过其到 V V 上的投影 D ⊤ ​ c D^{\top}c 依赖于输入，外加一个所有输入共享的常数偏移量。

sents.en: An unrelated prompt is therefore displaced only through its projection onto V V and the shared offset, and the objective below penalizes this displacement on a retained set of prompts we want left alone.
sents.zh: 因此，一个无关的提示仅通过其在 V V 上的投影和共享偏移量被移动，而下文的目标函数会对保留的一组我们希望保持不变的提示上的这种移动进行惩罚。

sents.en: Because the offset is shared by every input, this penalty keeps it small wherever it would move retained prompts.
sents.zh: 由于该偏移量由所有输入共享，因此只要它会使保留的提示发生移动，这种惩罚就会使其保持较小。

paragraphs.en: Rotation-based methods such as OCE ( Sun et al., 2026 ) search for a rotation matrix aligning erase and anchor embeddings. But a rotation is a distance-preserving isometry. It keeps the distance between a target and its anchor fixed, so it cannot map the target onto the anchor while leaving the anchor in place. An affine map need not preserve distances, so it can merge two distinct points. Figure 3 contrasts the three editing primitives.

paragraphs.en: Each concept uses three mutually disjoint prompt sets. The edit is fitted on paired, template-parallel erase and anchor prompts that differ only in the concept word, with the retained set ℋ \mathcal{H} of equation ( 1 ) built from the anchor embeddings and the null prompt. Evaluation uses a separate set of 30 unseen prompts per concept. Erasure can only be assessed if the base model produces the concept in the first place, so each evaluation prompt is fixed to a seed for which every evaluator of its axis recognizes the concept on the unedited model (Appendix A ). All methods and ablations reuse these (prompt, seed) pairs, which removes sampling noise from comparisons between them.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 reports 3D-US, together with its forgetting ( F F ) and preservation ( P P ) components, for each method at its best configuration from the hyperparameter sweeps described below, with the per-axis mode assignment of Section 3 . STAGE attains the highest 3D-US on every axis and overall, with a margin of at least 9.8 points over OCE, the strongest baseline, on every axis. STAGE has the highest 3D-US on 10 of the 15 concepts, and on 9 of them it matches or exceeds both baselines in forgetting and in preservation at the same time, so its advantage does not come from trading one objective for the other. STAGE keeps preservation above 0.84 on every shape and material concept, whereas OCE drops as low as 0.57. The object axis is the hardest to preserve for every method. OCE falls below 0.5 on all five objects and STAGE on two of them, cat and teddy bear, while staying above 0.82 on the other three. UCE preserves objects best (0.65) but forgets far less than STAGE (0.57 vs 0.90). Appendix D lists the values for every concept. STAGE also redirects erased concepts to their anchors most often. Averaged over concepts and evaluators, 54.9% of the edited evaluation assets are recognized as the anchor, compared with 33.7% for UCE and 30.0% for OCE, and at least 80% on the object axis (Appendix D ). paragraphs.en: We introduced STAGE, a training-free, closed-form framework for stage-aware concept erasure in native text-to-3D generation. Our analysis on TRELLIS shows that the stage an edit must reach depends on concept type. By combining a subspace derived from the differences between erase and anchor embeddings with an affine correction, STAGE enables targeted weight edits without additional inference cost. Across 15 shape, material, and object concepts, it achieves a 3D Unlearning Score of 66.7, compared with 53.2 for the strongest adapted baseline under the same stage assignment. These results support stage-aware editing as an effective approach to balancing concept removal and preservation in native 3D generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 STAGE，一个无需训练、具有闭式解的框架，用于在原生文本到 3D 生成中实现阶段感知的概念擦除。 我们对 TRELLIS 的分析表明，编辑必须达到的阶段取决于概念类型。 通过将源于擦除嵌入与锚定嵌入差异的子空间与仿射校正相结合，STAGE 能够在不产生额外推理成本的情况下实现有针对性的权重编辑。 在 15 个形状、材质和物体概念上，其 3D 遗忘分数达到 66.7，而采用相同阶段分配的最强自适应基线模型仅为 53.2。 这些结果支持将阶段感知编辑视为在原生 3D 生成中平衡概念移除与保留的有效方法。

paragraphs.en: The scope of quantitative erasure evaluation depends on the pretrained generator’s capabilities and the available evaluators. Our protocol therefore verifies that target concepts are expressed and recognized before editing, and combines semantic and physical evidence to assess their removal. Extending this evaluation to finer-grained and domain-specific concepts requires distinguishing the removal of a target attribute from changes to closely related attributes. Developing benchmarks that capture these distinctions is a natural direction for future work.

paragraphs.en: Each concept has 120 erase prompts and 120 anchor prompts, and the two sets are template-parallel. Erase prompt i i and anchor prompt i i come from the same sentence template and differ only in the concept word, as in “An analog clock crafted from wood.” and “An analog clock crafted from metal.” . In shape and material prompts, the concept describes an everyday object such as a cushion, a lamp, a vase, or a clock, and the templates vary how it is attached to that object, as in “An analog clock is strictly circular.” or “A soft cushion made of wood.” . All shape concepts share the same 120 templates, and so do all material concepts. In object prompts, the concept is the object itself. The object concepts share the same 120 sentence frames, with some adjectives chosen to suit each object, as in “A fast and sleek car.” and “A small and fluffy cat.” . Each shape concept is named by two different words, such as round and circular for sphere (Table 4 ), and each word appears in 60 of its 120 erase prompts, so the edit removes the shape under both names. Because the anchor word replaces the concept word in the same template, some anchor prompts are not fully grammatical, for example “An analog clock is strictly ring.” . This is intended, since each pair then differs only in the concept word. When the two words differ in token count, as for chair and teddy bear , STAGE pairs only the final positions, where both states already encode the full prompt (Appendix B ). The same 120 pairs are given to all three editors, and none of them is used for evaluation. Table 5 shows one example per axis.
paragraphs.zh: 每个概念都包含 120 个擦除提示和 120 个锚定提示，且这两组提示是模板平行的。 擦除提示 i 和锚定提示 i 来自相同的句子模板，仅概念词不同，例如“一个由木材制成的模拟时钟”和“一个由金属制成的模拟时钟”。 在形状和材料提示中，概念描述的是日常物品，如坐垫、灯具、花瓶或时钟，而模板则变化了它与该物品的连接方式，例如“一个模拟时钟是严格圆形的”或“一个由木材制成的柔软坐垫”。 所有形状概念共享相同的 120 个模板，所有材料概念也是如此。 在物品提示中，概念就是物品本身。 物品概念共享相同的 120 个句子框架，并选择适合每个物品的一些形容词，例如“一辆快速而流畅的汽车”和“一只小巧而蓬松的猫”。 每个形状概念都由两个不同的词命名，例如球体的“round”和“circular”（表 4），每个词都出现在其 120 个擦除提示中的 60 个里，因此编辑会同时以这两个名称移除该形状。 由于锚定词在相同模板中替换了概念词，某些锚定提示并非完全符合语法规则，例如“一个模拟时钟是严格环形的”。 这是有意设计的，因为这样每对提示就仅以概念词不同而区分。 当两个词的词元数量不同时（如椅子和泰迪熊），STAGE 仅对齐最终位置，此时两种状态都已完整编码了提示（附录 B）。 所有三个编辑器都获得了相同的 120 对提示，且其中没有任何一对用于评估。 表 5 展示了每个轴的一个示例。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation prompts are longer descriptions of a single asset that clearly shows the concept (Table 5 ). To stay close to the prompts TRELLIS handles best, we first studied the TRELLIS paper ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) and the text prompts behind the example assets shown on its official project page, and followed their style as closely as possible. For each concept, the Gemini language model then generated a pool of about 200 candidate prompts in this style. We run a seed search over these candidates on the unedited TRELLIS. For each candidate in turn, we generate the asset with seeds 0 , 1 , … , 9 0,1,\dots,9 and accept the first (prompt, seed) pair whose asset every evaluator of the axis assigns to the target concept, using one rendered view for CLIP and MINC-23 and the point cloud for Uni3D. The search stops once 30 pairs are accepted, which every concept reached. The accepted pairs are stored together with their seeds, and every method and ablation regenerates exactly these 30 pairs before and after its edit. This keeps only prompts on which TRELLIS expresses the concept at all, since forgetting cannot be measured otherwise. At the concept level, 3D-US additionally requires E ^ e , c pre ≥ τ = 0.5 \hat{E}^{\mathrm{pre}}_{e,c}\geq\tau=0.5 for every evaluator on four views (Section 4 ), which all 15 concepts satisfy.

paragraphs.en: All three editors are closed-form and run through one shared pipeline, so they differ only in the update they compute. They receive the same 120 erase and anchor prompt pairs per concept (Appendix A ) and no additional preservation prompts. All prompts are encoded once with the frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 text encoder that conditions TRELLIS, with 77 token positions. UCE and OCE use one embedding per prompt, the hidden state at its last content token, and STAGE uses the aligned token states of Section 3 , which Table 10 compares with the single embedding per prompt. All editors receive the same caption second moment K 0 K_{0} . Every editor modifies the text-conditioning projection ( to_kv , which maps the text states to keys and values) of every cross-attention layer in the stages selected by the per-axis mode of Section 3 , which is 28 layers per stage. STAGE and UCE edit both the key and the value half of each projection, as the original UCE does. OCE edits the value half, which at its tuned configuration scores far higher here than the key half edited by the original OCE or both halves (Table 13 ). After the edit, all methods generate the same (prompt, seed) pairs with the same sampler settings and are scored by the same evaluation code (Appendix C ). The hyperparameters of every method are selected with the same one-at-a-time protocol (Appendix E ).
paragraphs.zh: 所有三个编辑器均为闭式结构，并通过一条共享管道运行，因此它们仅在计算出的更新部分存在差异。 每个概念下，它们接收相同的 120 个擦除与锚点提示对（附录 A），且无额外的保留提示。 所有提示均使用冻结的 CLIP ViT-L/14 文本编码器进行一次性编码，该编码器为 TRELLIS 提供条件输入，共包含 77 个令牌位置。 UCE 和 OCE 每个提示使用一个嵌入向量，即其最后一个内容令牌的隐藏状态；而 STAGE 则使用第 3 节中描述的对齐令牌状态，表 10 将其与每个提示使用单个嵌入向量的方式进行了比较。 所有编辑器接收相同的标题二阶矩 K₀ K_{0}。 每个编辑器都会修改第 3 节中各轴模式所选阶段中的每个交叉注意力层的文本条件化投影（to_kv，该投影将文本状态映射为键和值），每个阶段包含 28 个层。 STAGE 和 UCE 会同时编辑每个投影的键和价值部分，这与原始 UCE 的做法一致。 OCE 仅编辑价值部分；在其调优配置下，该部分的得分在此处远高于原始 OCE 所编辑的键部分或两个部分同时被编辑的情况（表 13）。 编辑完成后，所有方法均使用相同的采样器设置生成相同的（提示，种子）对，并由相同的评估代码（附录 C）进行评分。 每种方法的超参数均通过相同的逐个调整协议（附录 E）进行选择。

sents.en: All three editors are closed-form and run through one shared pipeline, so they differ only in the update they compute.
sents.zh: 所有三个编辑器均为闭式结构，并通过一条共享管道运行，因此它们仅在计算出的更新部分存在差异。

sents.en: They receive the same 120 erase and anchor prompt pairs per concept (Appendix A ) and no additional preservation prompts.
sents.zh: 每个概念下，它们接收相同的 120 个擦除与锚点提示对（附录 A），且无额外的保留提示。

sents.en: All prompts are encoded once with the frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 text encoder that conditions TRELLIS, with 77 token positions.
sents.zh: 所有提示均使用冻结的 CLIP ViT-L/14 文本编码器进行一次性编码，该编码器为 TRELLIS 提供条件输入，共包含 77 个令牌位置。

sents.en: UCE and OCE use one embedding per prompt, the hidden state at its last content token, and STAGE uses the aligned token states of Section 3 , which Table 10 compares with the single embedding per prompt.
sents.zh: UCE 和 OCE 每个提示使用一个嵌入向量，即其最后一个内容令牌的隐藏状态；而 STAGE 则使用第 3 节中描述的对齐令牌状态，表 10 将其与每个提示使用单个嵌入向量的方式进行了比较。

sents.en: All editors receive the same caption second moment K 0 K_{0} .
sents.zh: 所有编辑器接收相同的标题二阶矩 K₀ K_{0}。

sents.en: Every editor modifies the text-conditioning projection ( to_kv , which maps the text states to keys and values) of every cross-attention layer in the stages selected by the per-axis mode of Section 3 , which is 28 layers per stage.
sents.zh: 每个编辑器都会修改第 3 节中各轴模式所选阶段中的每个交叉注意力层的文本条件化投影（to_kv，该投影将文本状态映射为键和值），每个阶段包含 28 个层。

sents.en: STAGE and UCE edit both the key and the value half of each projection, as the original UCE does.
sents.zh: STAGE 和 UCE 会同时编辑每个投影的键和价值部分，这与原始 UCE 的做法一致。

sents.en: OCE edits the value half, which at its tuned configuration scores far higher here than the key half edited by the original OCE or both halves (Table 13 ).
sents.zh: OCE 仅编辑价值部分；在其调优配置下，该部分的得分在此处远高于原始 OCE 所编辑的键部分或两个部分同时被编辑的情况（表 13）。

sents.en: After the edit, all methods generate the same (prompt, seed) pairs with the same sampler settings and are scored by the same evaluation code (Appendix C ).
sents.zh: 编辑完成后，所有方法均使用相同的采样器设置生成相同的（提示，种子）对，并由相同的评估代码（附录 C）进行评分。

sents.en: The hyperparameters of every method are selected with the same one-at-a-time protocol (Appendix E ).
sents.zh: 每种方法的超参数均通过相同的逐个调整协议（附录 E）进行选择。

paragraphs.en: STAGE follows Section 3 . For a template-parallel pair whose prompts have the same token count, all 77 aligned positions are paired, and positions whose two states coincide (relative difference below 10 − 4 10^{-4} ) are dropped. These are the positions before the concept word, which are identical under the causal text encoder. When the token counts differ, positions from the later of the two last content tokens onward are paired, where both states already encode the full prompt. This gives between 8,317 and 8,627 token pairs per concept. Pairing every position matches how TRELLIS reads the text, since it feeds all 77 token states, including those after the end-of-text token, to every cross-attention layer without a padding mask. The text embedding also reaches the to_kv projections without any normalization, so folding T T into both stages (Mode-SL) is equivalent to replacing every text embedding c c by T ⁡ ( c ) T(c) , and Mode-S or Mode-L applies this replacement for one stage only. The retained set ℋ \mathcal{H} contains the anchor state of every pair, with weight β \beta , and all 77 token states of the empty prompt, which TRELLIS uses as the unconditional branch of classifier-free guidance, with weight β \beta times the null-prompt multiplier. The subspace rank is capped at r r and at singular values below 10 − 3 10^{-3} of the largest one. All solves use double precision, and the correction is folded into both the weight and the bias of each projection (equation ( 2 )). Table 9 lists the swept values of r r , β \beta , the null-prompt multiplier, γ \gamma , λ \lambda , and α \alpha .
paragraphs.zh: STAGE 遵循第 3 节。 对于提示词具有相同词元数量的模板-平行对，所有 77 个对齐位置都会被配对，而两个状态重合的位置（相对差异低于 10⁻⁴）则被舍弃。 这些是概念词之前的位置，在因果文本编码器中它们是相同的。 当词元数量不同时，从两个最后内容词元中较晚者开始的位置会被配对，此时两个状态均已完整编码提示词。 这样每个概念可获得 8,317 到 8,627 个词元对。 配对所有位置的方式与 TRELLIS 读取文本的方式一致，因为它会将全部 77 个词元状态（包括文本结束标记之后的状态）送入每一层交叉注意力，且不使用填充掩码。 文本嵌入也未经任何归一化处理便直接传入 to_kv 投影，因此将 T T 折叠到两个阶段（Mode-SL）中，等同于将每个文本嵌入 c c 替换为 T⁡(c)；而 Mode-S 或 Mode-L 仅对其中一个阶段执行此替换。 保留的集合 ℋ \mathcal{H} 包含每对中的锚定状态及其权重 β，以及空提示词的全部 77 个词元状态；TRELLIS 将这些状态用作无分类器引导的无条件分支，其权重为 β 乘以空提示词乘子。 子空间秩的上限为 r，且奇异值需小于最大奇异值的 10⁻³。 所有求解过程均使用双精度浮点，且修正项被折叠到每个投影的权重和偏置中（方程 (2)）。 表 9 列出了 r、β、空提示词乘子、γ、λ 和 α 的遍历值。

paragraphs.en: Each axis is scored by two evaluators that see different evidence, rendered images and either a point cloud or a material classifier. We measure how often they agree on the top-1 label of the same asset (Table 6 ), using the runs of Table 1 . Before the edit, agreement is high for shape and object concepts. After the edit, the generations cover everything from unchanged assets to fully redirected ones and differ between methods. On these, the two evaluators agree on 69 to 74% of the assets, with Cohen’s κ \kappa between 0.60 0.60 and 0.67 0.67 , far above the value of 0 0 expected by chance. The image and 3D evaluators therefore track the same change, while each also registers changes the other does not, which is what the geometric mean of Section 4 combines. The ranking of Table 1 also does not depend on how 3D-US aggregates its parts. paragraphs.en: Table 10 removes or replaces one component of STAGE at a time, at the default configuration ( α = 1 \alpha{=}1 ). Without the offset n 0 n_{0} , the correction can only act through the subspace term, forgetting drops on every axis (mean F F of 0.31, 0.20, and 0.47 instead of 0.54, 0.33, and 0.89), and overall 3D-US falls to 41.3. Without the subspace confinement ( D = I D{=}I ), the correction reads the whole embedding, which raises forgetting on the shape axis but lowers preservation on every axis, most on the object axis (mean P P of 0.36 instead of 0.73), and overall 3D-US falls to 54.1. Replacing the affine map with the orthogonal map inside the same subspace that best aligns erase and anchor states (orthogonal Procrustes, without offset) gives 45.3, which isolates the argument of Figure 3 . Finally, fitting STAGE only on the last content token of each prompt, the single embedding per prompt that UCE and OCE receive (120 pairs instead of 8,317 to 8,627), gives 59.0, close to the 60.1 of token-level pairing and above both tuned baselines (53.2 for OCE and 47.5 for UCE). The advantage of STAGE therefore does not come from its additional token pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 表 10 在默认配置（α = 1）下，每次移除或替换 STAGE 的一个组件。 如果没有偏移量 n₀，校正只能通过子空间项起作用，导致每个轴上都出现遗忘现象（平均 F 分别为 0.31、0.20 和 0.47，而非 0.54、0.33 和 0.89），整体 3D-US 降至 41.3。 如果没有子空间约束（D = I），校正会读取整个嵌入，这会增加形状轴上的遗忘，但会降低每个轴上的保留度，尤其是在对象轴上（平均 P 为 0.36，而非 0.73），整体 3D-US 降至 54.1。 在同一子空间内，将仿射映射替换为能够最佳对齐擦除状态和锚定状态的正交映射（正交 Procrustes，无偏移量），得到 45.3，这孤立了图 3 中的论点。 最后，仅在每个提示的最后一个内容标记上拟合 STAGE，即 UCE 和 OCE 接收的每个提示的单个体嵌入（120 对，而非 8,317 至 8,627 对），得到 59.0，接近于标记级配对的 60.1，且高于两种调优基线（OCE 为 53.2，UCE 为 47.5）。 因此，STAGE 的优势并非来自其额外的标记对。

paragraphs.en: Each cross-attention layer reads the text through one projection whose output is split into keys and values. Table 13 compares editing the key half, the value half, or both. At the default configurations, all three editors do best when the value half is edited, alone or together with the keys, and editing only the keys erases almost nothing. STAGE edits both halves, since its correction is consistent for keys and values, and UCE edits both halves as in its original implementation. For OCE, the table also reports the configuration of Table 1 , where the value edit scores far higher than the key edit of the original OCE or the edit of both halves. Setting λ = 0 \lambda=0 in the tuned OCE, which recovers its original objective, gives 52.1 instead of 53.2.
paragraphs.zh: 每个交叉注意力层都通过一个投影读取文本，其输出被拆分为键和值。 表 13 比较了编辑键部分、值部分或两者同时进行的效果。 在默认配置下，三种编辑器在单独编辑值部分或与键一起编辑时表现最佳，而仅编辑键几乎不会删除任何内容。 STAGE 会同时编辑两个部分，因为其修正对键和值是一致的；UCE 也会像其原始实现一样同时编辑两个部分。 对于 OCE，该表还报告了表 1 中的配置，其中值部分的得分远高于原始 OCE 的键部分编辑或同时编辑两个部分的得分。 在调优后的 OCE 中设置 λ = 0 \lambda=0，这会恢复其原始目标，此时得分为 52.1，而非 53.2。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 places every non-default configuration of the three sweeps by its mean forgetting and preservation over the 15 concepts. The configurations of STAGE form a front above those of both baselines. Every baseline configuration with mean forgetting above 0.15 is matched or exceeded in both forgetting and preservation by at least one configuration of STAGE. The baseline configurations outside this front forget almost nothing and keep high preservation only because they barely change the model.
paragraphs.zh: 图6根据三种扫描的非默认配置在15个概念上的平均遗忘率和保留率，对它们进行了定位。 STAGE的配置形成了一个位于两种基线配置之上的前沿。 所有平均遗忘率高于0.15的基线配置，在遗忘和保留这两个方面，都至少被STAGE的一种配置所匹配或超越。 位于该前沿之外的基线配置几乎不会遗忘任何内容，并且之所以能保持高保留率，仅仅是因为它们几乎没有改变模型。
